title: Mute Players Fabric
description: Mute players on Fabric - modern non-dinosaur versions!
body:
This is a basic fabric mod that lets you mute and unmute players for 1.21.8.

/mute <player>   
/unmute <player>

Works as expected.
It functions by cancelling their chat packets in a mixin. 
I recommend building using the View source link - I only built like one version for releases on Modrinth but the basic code should work on a wide range of versions.
